verdict: Supplied native R5 evidence is internally consistent with its exact captured sources and the independently replayed logical components; no actionable finding within this component scope.
reviewKind: Independent audit of a supplied actual native campaign, with independent non-database producer/held-probe/whole-V2/codec replay.

suppliedCampaign.observationsQualification: 869 recorded assertions, including repeated per-operation IDs and repeated evidence comparisons; not 869 unique acceptance requirements.

engine.version: PostgreSQL 18.6 (Debian 18.6-1.pgdg13+2) on aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Debian 14.2.0-19) 14.2.0, 64-bit

nativeClaimsReviewed: The reviewed runner re-executed the original WithinOperation producer and original whole-V2 inspector before each operation. The supplied per-operation observations match the archived authored source/cut/selection and complete result objects.

All 234 recorded SQL statements reconstruct exactly from the archived producer resources/full cell JSON, optional staged mutation and actual issued SQL artifact. The native driver columns are explicitly output_0 then __weft_source_rows.

The independently captured eligible key/cell relation equals the exact expected producer resource population, with ordered capture by private key. The emitted SQL result is checked as a complete key/cell bag. No query ordering guarantee is inferred.

All six mixed/empty supplemental operations have actual driver/capture counts 4,0,4,0,4,0. The three mixed populations retain four unique private keys with 3,1,1 distinct cell values. Duplicate values do not collapse rows. The original census includes denied r2; resources and native eligible rows exclude it.

Original String, null, known absence, withheld, and pure presentation-null cells retain their full V2 cell carrier. Original disclosure of known-absent input correctly emits an absent wire cell. The storage header remains stored-transformed via vault/1; no vault operation or pre-storage substitution is represented.

Four negative operations alter only the checker frame: missing row, duplicate row, SQL-null cell collapse and changed header. Each retains unmodified actual driver rows and refuses generically with no partial nativeBatch/publicInspection result. These are not altered-SQL campaigns.

The fifth negative changes the actual staged full cell JSON to selected occurrence 999/999. Capture and driver agree on that altered cell, structural Rust transport checking succeeds, and the original whole-V2 inspector refuses. This demonstrates the mandatory separate semantic barrier.

All preparation, artifact, binding, request and transport report hashes match the exact recorded bytes. Four original opaque semantic source bytes/identities, the model pin, unadmitted fixture binding and exact producer profile agree with the original producer packet.

cleanup.assessment: Consistent supplied successful owned cleanup evidence, checked against the reviewed exact cleanup implementation; no fresh Docker/daemon inspection was performed by reviewer.

record.storageCleanupScope: exact tmpfs-only storage and container absence

cleanup.qualification: The receipt records exact single tmpfs storage at /var/lib/postgresql, matching ownership label before removal, successful removal, and the exact named-container absence response afterward. Full cleanup requires both container removal and the observed tmpfs-only layout. This is not a general unexpected-volume erasure claim.

independentChecks.qualification: Executes the exact source-archived supplied binary in fresh processes with actual retained borrowing and checked commands. Preparations, artifacts, reports/refusals and exits reproduce exactly. No new build or database execution in this audit.

independentChecks.name: Fresh actual atomic producer and original whole-V2 JSON/YAML checks
independentChecks.qualification: All 52 fresh producer results match exactly. The 47 positive native batches round-trip through JSON and YAML. The staged invalid-selection batch reproduces the exact refused inspector verdict and both encoding/decoding refusal channels.

custody.archive: All 1285 manifest entries are unique, each archived member hashes to both manifest and receipt pin, and the archive has exactly the declared members plus manifest. Every original current source endpoint matched at initial audit and after non-DB replays.
custody.reconstruction: The original 102-source UMF generator closure is reconstructed byte-for-byte from the native archive and verified again after replay. All actual opaque semantic source bytes, their digests, model bytes and selected occurrence fields are checked separately.
custody.qualification: Source endpoint equality does not establish held-file or ABA resistance. External compiler/runtime/OS/Docker executable closure is not hermetic. The local replay records Bun 1.4.2, Python 3.9.6, Ajv 8.20.0 and YAML 2.9.1; 770 copied external package files are pinned before and checked after replay.

qualification.reason: The initial auxiliary provenance check incorrectly equated the policy original disposition with the emitted cell disposition for known-absent input. Original disclosure of a known absent field correctly emits the V2 absent cell. Corrected expectation derives absence from the original matching resource fact; the two failures were allowed:absent and mixed-string r4. Source, supplied native evidence and all earlier successful audits/replays are unchanged.

scopeLimits: This is an audit of supplied actual PostgreSQL 18.6 evidence plus independent non-database replays. The reviewer did not execute SQL, create a container, or independently observe the daemon during the supplied campaign.

The fixture executes as excluded administrator postgres. Supplied trusted logical facts, model/source hashes, a read-purpose declaration and an unadmitted fixture binding do not authenticate a native caller/Subject, source, complete current cut, host role/mapping or grant.

The native table materializes already-produced eligible resources. Its SQL eligible flag and complete relation capture test transport of that supplied population; they do not independently implement or prove native membership/authorization joins. The deliberately excluded fixture row tests the SQL eligibility filter only.
The producer census includes denied identities and rule truth; it remains private host/owner composition data, not public query output or reader diagnostics. This review grants no release authority.

The structural transport report remains authority:false, securityReady:false, nativeAdmission:required. Whole UMF semantic validation, closing authenticated source/caller/current-cut checks, native completeness and guarded release remain mandatory host obligations.

No broader operators, transformation/vault authority, default/public runtime ABI, production backend admission or required acceptance case is promoted. Original 158 UMF required cases/34 criteria remain 45 implemented and 113 missing as reported by the existing gate; that broad gate was not rerun in this audit. The original Weft acceptance allocation likewise remains unchanged.

Counts here are component observations and repeated audit assertions, not independent proofs or acceptance coverage totals. The 25 refused original producer packets are retained in source inputs but were not presented as successful native transport operations.

The supplied receipt preserves decoded driver rows, exact SQL strings and runner observations, not an independently signed database transcript. This audit verifies their source-consistent correspondence and reproduces the logical checks without claiming independent native execution.
disposition: No additional correction is required for retaining this exact component evidence. Any later source, ABI, role, operator or admission change requires its own qualified review and evidence.
